title: Prices, incomes, construction and rents in Portugal's housing market, 2008–2025: a reproducible descriptive assessment

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
creators.affiliation: ESMAD – Escola Superior de Media Artes e Design, Politécnico do Porto

description:
Research release v1.0.0: a reproducible descriptive assessment of house prices, incomes, construction, population and rents in Portugal, its 9 NUTS 2 and 26 NUTS 3 regions and 308 municipalities, 2008–2025.

The archive contains the research report (REPORT.md), 63 pinned source files from INE, Eurostat and the ECB with SHA-256 checksums, standard-library Python code, unit and reproduction tests, generated results and 19 figures. Running python reproduce.py verifies the checksums, runs the tests and rebuilds every result byte for byte.

The report separates established descriptive findings, descriptive associations and unresolved causal hypotheses. None of its associations is causal.

Code and documentation: Apache License 2.0. Third-party data remain under their providers' terms (Eurostat, INE, ECB, PORDATA) and are redistributed unmodified with source acknowledgement.
